GHA.note: Only a regulatory framework for data centres is discussed; no facility is stated.

facts.fact: NITA's Director General said a draft National Data Centre and Cloud Computing Regulatory Framework, which covers licensing, data localisation, security, sustainability and competition, was under review at a validation workshop in Accra.
facts.system: National Data Centre and Cloud Computing Regulatory Framework

GHA.note: The framework is said to align with international standards, with no named standard, membership or rule.
NITA is named as a regulator of the framework; nothing stated on its running systems for government.
No nationally owned data centre is stated.
A validation workshop is described, but no one outside government is named as taking part.
Smart Africa speakers appear at a Ghana workshop; no membership, agreement or meeting of an African body is stated.
